items.title: Gate new LLM callers on the approved gateway and tier contract
items.summary:
## Goal

Add one deterministic repository-level audit that makes a newly introduced direct chat-completion call or free chat-model override fail before merge unless it uses the approved gateway/tier boundary or documents an explicit exception.

## Context — measured 2026-09-02

The current defects survived because each caller was locally reasonable: model options remained strings, transport injection was optional in places, and environment drift checks verified names rather than allowed values.

items.summary:

On the 1.20.x builds, the enchanting table never offers vanilla `minecraft:unbreaking`
on **any** item — pickaxes, swords, armour, or books. Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch
